text.EN: Please… let me stay. We have been walking for days, and I do not know how much longer the others can keep going.

text.EN: I am not asking for much. A roof, a meal, and a chance to be useful. Please let us join you.

text.EN: You have a settlement. We have nothing left but each other. If there is room, I will work for it.
text.TL: You have a pamayanan. We have nothing left but each other. If there is room, I will trabaho for it.

text.EN: Thank you. I thought I would have to keep walking until there was nowhere left to go.

text.EN: You're awake already. I was hoping you'd sleep a little longer.

text.EN: How are you holding up?
text.TL: Kamusta ka na?

text.EN: Do you need any help?
text.TL: Kailangan mo ba ng anumang tulong?

text.EN: Still standing. Go ahead.
text.TL: Nakatayo pa rin. Sige na.

text.EN: Tired, but ready if the group needs me.
text.TL: Tired, but ready if the grupo needs me.

text.EN: A little rest would help. I appreciate you asking.
text.TL: Makakatulong ang kaunting pahinga. Pinahahalagahan ko ang pagtatanong mo.

text.EN: How are you holding up?
text.TL: Kamusta ka na?

text.EN: Do you need any help?
text.TL: Kailangan mo ba ng anumang tulong?

text.EN: I'm managing. What did you want to ask?
text.TL: pinamamahalaan ko. Ano ang gusto mong itanong?

text.EN: I'm still breathing. That's enough for now.
text.TL: humihinga pa ako. Tama na sa ngayon.

text.EN: I'll manage, but thanks for asking.
text.TL: Aayusin ko, pero salamat sa pagtatanong.

text.EN: How are you really doing?
text.TL: Kamusta ka na talaga?

text.EN: Let me help.
text.TL: Hayaan mo akong tumulong.

text.EN: I'll be honest with you, {playerFirstName}. Ask.
text.TL: Magiging tapat ako sa iyo, {playerFirstName}. Magtanong.

text.EN: Better now that you're here.
text.TL: Mas mabuti na ngayong nandito ka na.

text.EN: All right. Just stay close for a minute.
text.TL: Sige. Manatiling malapit sa isang minuto.

text.EN: I have work for you.
text.TL: may trabaho ako sayo.

text.EN: Report on your current work.
text.TL: Mag-ulat sa iyong kasalukuyang gawain.

text.EN: I'm ready. What needs doing?
text.TL: handa na ako. Ano ang kailangang gawin?

text.EN: Tell me what needs doing.
text.TL: Sabihin mo sa akin kung ano ang kailangang gawin.

text.EN: Everything is on track for now.
text.TL: Ang lahat ay nasa track sa ngayon.
